messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "For each pair of elements (x_i, y_i) after broadcasting x and y to the same shape, compute the GCD of |x_i| and |y_i| using the Euclidean algorithm (repeated division until remainder is zero).",
    "If both inputs are scalars, return the GCD as a single integer.",
    "If inputs are lists, return a list of GCDs for corresponding elements after broadcasting to the same shape (e.g., if one is scalar, it broadcasts to the length of the other).",
    "For empty lists, return an empty list."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Values and results must fit within signed 64-bit integers.",
    "No broadcasting beyond the specified rules (scalar/scalar, scalar/list, list/scalar, lists of same length).",
    "Inputs must be integers or 1-D lists of integers; non-integer or multi-dimensional inputs are invalid.",
    "The GCD is computed for absolute values of inputs."
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "Both inputs are empty lists: return empty list.",
    "One input is a scalar and the other is a list of length 0: return empty list.",
    "One input is a scalar and the other is a list of length 1: return a single integer.",
    "Both inputs are scalars: return a single integer.",
    "Inputs with different lengths but broadcastable (e.g., scalar and list): return a list of length equal to the longer list.",
    "Inputs with non-integer values: raise error (not supported per contract)."
  ],
  "inputs": "x and y are integers or 1-D lists of integers. Scalar/scalar inputs return an integer; scalar/list or list/scalar inputs return a list; lists of the same length (including empty) return a list. Inputs must be broadcastable if shapes differ.",
  "method_id": "numpy.gcd",
  "output": "A scalar integer if both inputs are scalars; otherwise, a list of integers representing the GCD of the absolute values of corresponding elements after broadcasting.",
  "purpose": "Compute the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the absolute values of two inputs, supporting scalar and list inputs with broadcasting rules.",
  "signature": "solve(x, y)"
}
